text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened one day, not long after
I became North Flight's dedicated Trainer.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, haaah, haaah... Whew~~!
All right,
that's my distance run finished!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, whoa...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm sorry. I'm fine.
Just a brief spell of lightheadedness.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It's gotten warm all of a sudden recently.
I must be ever so careful about sudden
temperature swings!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Wiping away sweat frequently,
reapplying sunscreen,
and staying hydrated with electrolytes...
*gulp* *gulp*... Phew...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as she said.
The weather had suddenly warmed up lately,
and the sunlight was growing harsher by the
day.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
That... sounds wise.
Pacing ourselves without rushing is key.
Once it cools down in the evening,
let's head back out to run!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Heat management, huh... Still,
methodical as North Flight naturally is,
she's already taking almost every standard
precaution imaginable.
choice_data_list: (Is there anything else we could t...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her "Big Sister" mentor from the training
club North Flight attended in the past.
Consulting her might give us a helpful
clue.

text_block_list.name: "Big Sister"
text_block_list.text:
—She had a similar bout of poor health
before.
It seems ultraviolet rays,
even more than the heat itself,
caused fatigue to build up inside her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Armed with the insights into North Flight's
physical traits,
I approached the problem from a fresh angle
and landed on a solution...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: —...Sunglasses?
choice_data_list: They might help reduce strain on y...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
UV damage is a major factor behind physical
fatigue.
A significant portion enters through the eyes,
causing stress to the brain as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That said,
pairing a school tracksuit with sunglasses
is definitely an uncommon look.
choice_data_list: If you don't like it, you really d...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all!
It's certainly a rare combination,
but it's not against the dress code.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
In some countries,
schools actually encourage students to wear
sunglasses. After all,
sunglasses were originally born from pure
utility...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I was so attached to the image of them being
a "midsummer fashion accessory"
that I forgot their primary purpose.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It sounds very much worth trying!
Let's test it out right away!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes...
this definitely eases that stinging sensation
in my eyes.
Putting them on made me realize just how
much strain had been building up.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
They restrict vision too much while running,
so I should take them off then,
but if I block the sunlight in between,
we can compare my fatigue levels!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Flight started wearing sunglasses during
breaks and while moving between tracks.
After monitoring her for several days of
continued training...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: —Hah, hah, hah, hah!
choice_data_list: Looking good! Take it to top speed...
Looking good! Take it to top speed...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Right! Haaaaaahhh—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
North Flight put on fantastic runs day after
day.
She showed zero signs of falling ill during
practice.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—My body feels so light,
even after training.
Looks like Operation Sunglasses is a roaring
success!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Getting advice from a completely different
perspective was such a huge help.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
You really are my personal stylist,
always finding ways to make me shine.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Less eye and brain fatigue means I fall
asleep so easily at night.
Plus,
wearing them gives me a real motivational
boost...
choice_data_list: Because they look stylish on you.
Because they look stylish on you.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Exactly!
Being fashionable even during training makes
it so much fun.
I picked these frames out down to the
millimeter to flatter my facial contours,
you know.
choice_data_list: No wonder. They look fantastic on you!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
My, do they really?
Fufufu...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, praise from the stylist~♪
Come to think of it,
I haven't worn these much lately...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Taking a closer look,
they really are chic...!
I think these are officially going into
heavy rotation this season♪
